title: Slop tells and hard failures
description: Every hard failure and counted signal the Kiekkist check measures (checker: auto) or the critique checks by hand (checker: manual), with thresholds, evidence class and source. The checker reads thresholds, costs and pattern lists from this pack; references/tells.md is generated from it (scripts/gen-tells-md.mjs). Counted, not banned: a signal over its threshold needs a written reason, not removal.

fields.kind: hard (fails the check: error or warn) | counted (slop signal, flagged when count > threshold.max) | info (counted, lower cost) | process (working rule, not measured)
fields.checker: auto = measured by kk_check; manual = critique checklist
fields.threshold: object read by the checker; null when not measured
fields.cost: score deduction per finding and cap (hard only)

items.name: Text contrast below WCAG AA
items.detect: computed colour of every text node over its effective background (opacity chain, layered backgrounds), every viewport
items.flag: below 4.5:1 (body) or 3:1 (large text ≥ 24 px or bold ≥ 18.66 px)
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.4.3. Dark mode is not yet emulated (open).

items.name: Contrast over a gradient not reliably measurable
items.name_de: Kontrast über Verlauf nicht sicher messbar
items.detect: worst gradient stop under the text
items.flag: worst stop below the AA ratio

items.name: Contrast over a photo not measurable
items.detect: text whose background stack ends in an image, video or large SVG
items.flag: any; check by eye or add a scrim

items.name: Horizontal overflow of the page
items.detect: `documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth` at 390, 768, 1440; the outermost sticking-out element is named
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.4.10 Reflow

items.name: Text running out of its container
items.detect: text line boxes outside their block (German compounds included); clipped boxes are reported as `content-clipped`

items.name: Text cut off by an overflow:hidden container
items.detect: text straddling the edge of a clipping container

items.name: Missing alt text on images
items.detect: `img`, `input[type=image]` without `alt` (empty `alt` is fine for decoration), `role=img` without a name

items.name: Links and buttons without accessible name
items.detect: name computed from aria-label, labelledby, text, alt, svg title
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 4.1.2; Vercel: icon-only buttons need aria-label

items.name: Click targets below 24 px and too close
items.name_de: Klickziele unter 24 px und zu eng
items.detect: bounding box of every target; inline links in running text are exempt
items.flag: below 24 × 24 px with a neighbour closer than the spacing exception

items.name: Touch targets below 44 px on mobile
items.detect: targets at viewports under 600 px
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.5.5 (AAA); platform guidelines

items.name: Form fields with text under 16 px
items.detect: computed `font-size` of text inputs, `select`, `textarea` at viewports under 600 px
items.note: iOS zooms the page on focus below 16 px

items.name: Zoom disabled in the viewport meta
items.detect: `user-scalable=no` or `maximum-scale` below 2 in `meta[name=viewport]`
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.4.4 Resize text

items.name: No visible focus
items.detect: keyboard walk (Tab, up to 40 steps at the widest viewport, 30 at the narrowest); for the first 15 targets outline, box-shadow, border, background, colour and underline are compared with the rest state
items.flag: focused style equals the rest style
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.4.7. Typical cause: `outline: none` without a `:focus-visible` replacement.

items.name: No reduced-motion handling
items.detect: elements with CSS animations or transitions ≥ 200 ms; the page is re-measured with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` emulated
items.flag: motion present and no element changes under reduce
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.3.3 (AAA); Vercel: honour prefers-reduced-motion

items.name: Third-party font CDN
items.detect: attempted requests (the checker blocks them and records the host)
items.flag: any request to a listed host
items.note: legal risk in the EU: IP address sent to a third party without consent (LG München I, 20.01.2022, 3 O 17493/20); see legal.md. Fontsource via jsDelivr counts too.

items.name: Third-party requests without need
items.detect: attempted requests to other origins than the target (blocked and recorded), font hosts excluded (see font-cdn)
items.note: consent duty for analytics, embeds, maps (TTDSG/TDDDG § 25, DSGVO); the brief decides which are needed

items.name: Placeholder text or images
items.detect: visible text matched against the placeholder list (DE and EN, word boundaries, case-insensitive); image and background URLs against placeholder hosts
items.note: Generic names (Acme, Max Mustermann) are invented proof as much as placeholders (§ 5 UWG when shipped).

items.name: Body line length too long
items.detect: paragraphs, list items and quotes with at least 2 lines at the widest viewport: widest line divided by mean character width
items.flag: above 80 characters; 76 to 80 only with line height ≥ 1.45
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.4.8 (AAA); 45 to 75 characters is the typographic canon

items.name: Content missing without JavaScript
items.detect: second load with JavaScript disabled at the widest viewport; visible text length compared with the JavaScript run
items.note: Also what crawlers, reader mode and AI agents see. Counters that start at 0 are counted separately (counter-zero-nojs).

items.name: More than one filled primary button per screen
items.name_de: Mehr als ein gefüllter Hauptbutton pro Bildschirm
items.detect: buttons with an opaque fill that differs from the ground they sit on, grouped by screen-high bands, every viewport
items.note: one primary action per screen; the second is secondary or a link

items.name: More than one primary button colour
items.name_de: Mehr als eine Farbe für Hauptbuttons
items.detect: distinct fill colours of filled buttons on the page (sRGB distance > 30)
items.note: one CTA colour sitewide; the checker sees one page, so check the other templates too

items.name: axe-core WCAG violations
items.detect: axe-core at every viewport and with the mobile menu opened, rules tagged wcag2a/aa, wcag21a/aa, wcag22aa and best-practice (audio-caption and css-orientation-lock enabled), without the rules measured above; WCAG A/AA violations are errors whatever their impact (`axe-critical`, `axe-serious`, `axe-moderate`, `axe-minor`, weighted 1.34/1/0.67/0.34), best-practice ones warnings (`axe-best-practice`); each finding carries its success criterion

items.name: Text still invisible after scrolling
items.name_de: Text nach dem Scrollen noch unsichtbar
items.detect: text at opacity 0 before scrolling that stays invisible after a full scroll

items.name: Page could not be loaded or measured
items.detect: navigation or measurement error at a viewport
items.flag: any; a page measured at no viewport scores 0

items.name: Colours outside the palette
items.detect: rendered colour weight farther than CIEDE2000 6 from every token (needs --tokens)
items.note: also catches raw near-black values that bypass the ink token

items.name: Fonts outside the tokens
items.detect: font families with at least 20 visible characters that are not in the tokens (needs --tokens)

items.name: No reflow at 320 px
items.detect: extra viewport 320×640 (same context as the narrowest width): horizontal scrolling of the page, text cut at the viewport edge or newly clipped by its box; tables, pre/code, maps, figures with media and scroll containers are exempt; fixed/sticky bars covering more than half the height are a warning
items.flag: page wider than 320 px or text cut (error); sticky bars > 50 % of the height (warning)

items.name: Text breaks with WCAG text spacing
items.detect: at the narrowest and widest viewport the WCAG test styles are injected (line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0.12em, word-spacing 0.16em, paragraph spacing 2em); only clipping, spill, ellipsis or line-clamp that was not there before counts
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.4.12 (AA). Typical cause: fixed heights or nowrap on buttons, badges, nav items.

items.name: Text-only zoom 200 % not supported
items.detect: root font size set to 200 % at the widest viewport: text elements that do not grow (px sizes) and new clipping
items.flag: fewer than half the text elements grow, or new clipping (heuristic)
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.4.4 (AA), heuristic; real zoom is covered by reflow-320.

items.name: Focused element hidden by sticky content
items.detect: during the keyboard walk at the narrowest and widest viewport, 9 points inside each focused element are hit-tested; points covered by a fixed or sticky element count
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.4.11 (AA), 2.4.12 (AAA). Fix with scroll-padding-top/bottom equal to the bar height.

items.name: Focus order jumps
items.detect: keyboard walk: positive tabindex, or the next focus target lies more than one screen height above the previous one
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.4.3 (A), heuristic

items.name: Keyboard trap
items.detect: keyboard walk: focus returns to an element already visited before the end of the page, and neither Shift+Tab (4 steps) nor Escape (for modal dialogs) leaves the cycle while focusable elements remain unreached; iframes holding focus for 15 steps are a warning (not inspectable)

items.name: Clickable element not reachable by keyboard
items.detect: an init script records click, pointer and touch listeners; elements with such a listener or an onclick attribute and cursor:pointer that are not focusable and contain no focusable element
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.1.1 (A). Event delegation on a parent is not seen (partial check).

items.name: Form field or icon below 3:1
items.detect: border (each side ≥ 1 px), fill or shadow of inputs, selects, textareas and custom checkboxes against the effective background; fill or stroke of icons in icon-only links and buttons

items.name: Control disappears in forced-colours mode
items.detect: screenshot of the top 2400 px at the widest viewport with and without forced-colors: active; a control or icon whose area has contrast normally and is flat in forced colours
items.note: EN 301 549 V4.1.1 clause 9.7 (not yet harmonised). Use currentColor, real borders, SVG fill.

items.name: forced-color-adjust: none
items.detect: computed forced-color-adjust on visible elements (inherited cases counted once)
items.flag: any outside logos and colour swatches

items.name: Page language does not match the text
items.detect: stopword count (German vs English) over the first 3,000 characters of main against <html lang>
items.flag: declared de/en but the text is clearly the other language (≥ 30 words, 2× majority)

items.name: Passage in another language without lang
items.detect: paragraphs, list items, headings, quotes and cells with ≥ 6 words whose stopwords point to the other language and no lang attribute on them or an ancestor
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 3.1.2 (AA), heuristic, German and English only

items.name: Visible label not in the accessible name
items.name_de: Sichtbare Beschriftung fehlt im zugänglichen Namen
items.detect: links and buttons with aria-label or aria-labelledby: the visible text (normalised) must be contained in the name
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.5.3 (A); best practice: the name starts with the visible text

items.name: Icon control named by title only, or icon read twice
items.name_de: Icon-Steuerelement nur per title benannt oder doppelt gelesen
items.detect: icon-only links/buttons whose only name is the title attribute; svg with role="img" or <title> inside a labelled control without aria-hidden
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 4.1.2 (A); title is not shown on touch and announced inconsistently

items.name: Moving content without pause
items.detect: running animations that are infinite or longer than 5 s on elements ≥ 2,500 px², autoplaying or playing video/audio with loop or longer than 5 s, marquee/blink; a button or link named pause/stop/anhalten/abspielen in the same section (or native controls) counts as control

items.name: Motion continues under reduced motion
items.detect: after emulating prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the same scan as pause-control-missing finds moving content
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.3.3 (AAA); house standard in motion.md

items.name: Audio plays automatically
items.detect: video/audio with autoplay (or playing) that is not muted
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.4.2 (A); axe no-autoplay-audio covers the timed case

items.name: Personal-data field without autocomplete
items.name_de: Feld für persönliche Daten ohne autocomplete
items.detect: name, id or label of text fields matched against personal-data tokens (name, e-mail, telefon, straße, plz, ort, firma …); missing, on or off autocomplete
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.3.5 (AA); axe autocomplete-valid checks invalid tokens

items.name: Paste blocked in login or code fields
items.name_de: Einfügen in Login- oder Codefeldern blockiert
items.detect: a synthetic paste event on password, one-time-code and single-character fields is cancelled (error); autocomplete="off" on passwords and split code boxes without one-time-code (warnings)

items.name: CAPTCHA found
items.detect: scripts, iframes and markup of reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile, Friendly Captcha, MTCaptcha, slider puzzles; image/text/puzzle challenges are warnings, score-based ones info
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 3.3.8 (AA): verify a non-cognitive alternative by hand

items.name: Same information asked twice
items.detect: fields named or labelled confirm/wiederholen/bestätigen next to e-mail (warning) or password (info, security exception)
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 3.3.7 (A), heuristic; multi-step flows stay manual

items.name: Required fields or error messages unclear
items.detect: required fields whose label gives no cue and no explanation of "*" in the form; forms with novalidate whose required fields have no aria-describedby/aria-errormessage and no live region
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 3.3.1 (A), 3.3.2 (A); message quality stays manual

items.name: Consent banner not usable by keyboard
items.detect: known CMP roots or a fixed/dialog box about cookies; keyboard walk must reach it (error if never, warning after step 5); first layer needs reject next to accept at ≥ 70 % of its size (warnings, see privacy-eu.md)
items.note: Practice item; WCAG 2.1.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.11 applied to the banner

items.name: No accessibility information linked
items.detect: link text or href matching Barrierefreiheit/Accessibility in the footer or the last quarter of the DOM; in site mode on every page
items.flag: missing (warning; error with profile bfsg/public or when shop or booking signals are found)
items.note: BFSG § 14 + Anlage 3; BITV 2.0 § 7. Never read as conformance.

items.name: Accessibility information incomplete
items.detect: same-origin fetch of the linked page: date and contact always; MLBF with profile bfsg; feedback, Schlichtung, compliance status and a date within 13 months with profile public
items.note: BFSG Anlage 3 lit. d; § 7 BITV 2.0

items.name: Leichte Sprache or DGS missing (public bodies)
items.name_de: Leichte Sprache oder DGS fehlt (öffentliche Stellen)
items.detect: profile public only: links on the start page to Leichte Sprache and Deutsche Gebärdensprache
items.note: § 4 BITV 2.0

items.name: Accessibility overlay widget
items.detect: script hosts and toolbar markup of overlay widgets (accessiBe, UserWay, Eye-Able, EqualWeb, AudioEye and others)
items.note: Overlays do not make a site conform; fix the source

items.name: Linked PDF not tagged
items.detect: up to 5 same-origin PDFs (≤ 10 MB): MarkInfo Marked, structure tree, /Lang, /Title, DisplayDocTitle (Flate object streams are inflated); creation date reported for the pre-28.06.2025 exemption
items.note: EN 301 549 clause 10; no PDF/UA verdict, use veraPDF or PAC

items.name: Navigation order differs between pages
items.detect: site mode: relative order of the links shared by the first nav of each page

items.name: Help mechanisms in a different order
items.detect: site mode: order of phone, e-mail, contact page, help/FAQ and chat in header and footer per page
items.flag: order differs (error); missing on some pages (warning)

items.name: Same target, different name
items.detect: site mode: links in nav, header and footer to the same path with different text

items.name: Duplicate or generic page titles
items.detect: site mode: equal <title> on several pages or titles like Home/Startseite/index
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.4.2 (A); axe document-title covers the missing title

items.name: Only one way to find pages
items.name_de: Nur ein Weg zu den Seiten
items.detect: site mode (≥ 3 pages): no search, no sitemap link

items.name: Dragging without a single-pointer alternative
items.detect: carousels (Swiper, Splide, Embla, Flickity, Glide, Slick, Owl, Keen) without buttons; before/after sliders without range input or buttons; draggable elements without move buttons

items.name: Hover content not dismissible or not hoverable
items.name_de: Hover-Inhalt nicht schließbar oder nicht erreichbar
items.detect: up to two nav items with hidden submenus (or tooltip triggers) at the widest viewport: hover, move onto the content (must stay), press Escape (must close)

items.name: Content locked to one orientation
items.detect: viewport 844×390 after the 320 px pass: main hidden or a full-screen "please rotate" overlay; axe css-orientation-lock covers CSS rotation

items.name: Invented proof
items.detect: statistics, logos, reviews or awards without a source the client confirmed
items.note: misleading commercial practice (UWG § 5; fake reviews are blacklisted)

items.name: Fonts without licence file
items.detect: font files in `assets/fonts/` without matching licence

items.name: Reflex fonts (model defaults)
items.detect: used families against the `reflex-fonts` pack (display-only entries count only in headings); fonts passed as brand fonts are exempt
items.flag: more than 0 without a written reason
items.note: brand fonts fixed by the client are exempt (--brand-font)

items.name: Font families in use
items.detect: first family of every text node with at least 20 characters

items.name: Three or more families inside one card
items.name_de: Drei oder mehr Schriften in einer Karte
items.detect: boxes with background, border or shadow; distinct families of the text inside

items.name: Pill / caps eyebrow labels above headings
items.detect: small uppercase, tracked or pill text directly above a heading

items.name: Tracked all-caps labels
items.detect: text with `text-transform: uppercase` and letter spacing ≥ 0.02 em
items.data: tiny uppercase labels on 57 % of weak vs 16 % of top sites (Taste study)

items.name: Single coloured/italic word in the H1
items.name_de: Einzelnes farbiges/kursives Wort in der H1
items.detect: a span of at most three words inside `h1` with different colour, style, family or gradient
items.note: with a serif display face this is the editorial-lane reflex (Playfair with one italic word)

items.name: Gradient text (background-clip:text)
items.detect: `background-clip: text` with a gradient

items.name: Monospace micro labels on non-data
items.detect: small monospace text (≤ 14.5 px, ≤ 40 characters) that is not data: no code, table, time, price, date, ID or mostly-digit text
items.data: monospace labels are MORE common on top sites (44 % vs 24 %, Taste study); only the non-data use is counted

items.name: Long centred text
items.detect: centred paragraphs with more than three lines

items.name: Four-line H1
items.detect: line count of the first visible `h1` at the widest viewport
items.data: 70 % of headlines fit in two lines (Taste study)

items.name: Text wall before the first scroll
items.detect: words of visible text inside the first viewport at the widest viewport

items.name: Orphan word in a heading
items.name_de: Einzelnes Wort in der letzten Überschriftenzeile
items.detect: `h1` and `h2` with at least four words and two lines whose last line holds one word, widest viewport
items.note: fix with `text-wrap: balance` or a non-breaking space

items.name: Skipped heading level
items.detect: visible headings in document order; a level deeper than previous + 1
items.note: WCAG 1.3.1 best practice (axe heading-order is moderate and therefore not in the axe pass)

items.name: Justified text
items.detect: `text-align: justify` on blocks with at least two lines
items.note: rivers on the web without fine hyphenation; WCAG 1.4.8 (AAA) advises against

items.name: Eyebrow repeating the heading
items.detect: eyebrow text whose words reappear in the heading below

items.name: Display serif with one italic word
items.detect: Playfair Display (or a similar high-contrast serif) in `h1` with one italic word; partly covered by highlight-word
items.flag: more than 0 without a written reason

items.name: More than one radius inside one card
items.detect: distinct border radii inside one card

items.name: Inter or the platform UI face as the only family on a brand surface
items.name_de: Inter oder Systemschrift als einzige Familie auf Markenflächen
items.detect: font stack inspection; product register is exempt
items.flag: more than 0 without a written reason

items.name: Three equal cards with icon on top
items.name_de: Drei gleiche Karten mit Icon oben
items.detect: three equal-width siblings in a row, at least two with an icon above their heading
items.data: icon-topped feature cards on 28 % of weak vs 1 % of top sites (Taste study)

items.name: Numbered markers 01 / 02 / 03 on non-sequences
items.detect: standalone "01" to "09" markers outside `ol`, tables and times; markers that sit together in one component (a list of steps or a timeline, not page sections with their own h2) are a real sequence and are not counted
items.data: index numbering is MORE common on top sites (38 % vs 21 %, Taste study); only section numbering without a sequence is counted

items.name: Big-number stat counters
items.detect: short numeric text ≥ 28 px or count-up markup
items.flag: more than 2 (any without a confirmed source is invented proof)

items.name: Counters showing 0 without JavaScript
items.detect: second load with JavaScript disabled: count-up markup or large numbers reading "0", "0+", "0 %"
items.note: own check in the maintainer's notes (friendventure.de showed "0 Standorte, 0+ Spezialist:innen" without JS); crawlers and screenshot tools see the zeros

items.name: Same border-radius on most boxes
items.name_de: Gleicher Eckenradius auf fast allen Boxen
items.detect: share of boxes (background, border or shadow; pills excluded) using the most frequent radius

items.name: One soft shadow on every raised box
items.name_de: Ein weicher Schatten auf jeder Box
items.detect: share of shadowed boxes using the most frequent shadow value
items.flag: above 90 % with at least 6 shadowed boxes

items.name: Large soft shadows
items.detect: outer shadows with blur ≥ 16 px, or offset ≥ 8 px with blur ≥ 10 px
items.note: RT1 counter: 1 px lines and slight surface changes instead of shadows

items.name: Nested cards
items.detect: a rounded box with background, border or shadow (≥ 120 × 60 px) inside another such box
items.note: impeccable bans them outright; Kiekkist counts (double-bezel may be one direction’s signature with a reason)

items.name: Accent-stripe cards
items.detect: groups of at least two siblings with a coloured left, right or top border ≥ 2 px that differs from their other borders
items.note: single callouts (a quote, a fact box) are not counted

items.name: Centred hero with two buttons
items.detect: centred `h1` with at least two buttons below it in the same block
items.data: centred statement over media on 24 % of weak vs 7 % of top sites (Taste study)

items.name: Logo wall
items.detect: a row of at least five image-only children
items.flag: more than 0 without permission and reason

items.name: Testimonial carousel
items.detect: slider markup or a horizontally scrolling container with quotes

items.name: A caption under every image
items.detect: pages with at least three content images, all inside `figure` with `figcaption`
items.note: a caption that names place and work is a good detail; on every image without content it is a reflex

items.name: Emoji in headings
items.detect: pictographic characters in headings
items.data: emoji on 26 % of weak vs 10 % of top sites (Taste study)

items.name: JavaScript errors on load
items.detect: uncaught exceptions and `console.error` during load and scroll (failed requests the checker blocked are ignored)

items.name: Autoplaying media without controls
items.detect: `video` or `audio` with `autoplay` and without `controls`
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 2.2.2: motion longer than 5 s needs pause, stop or hide

items.name: Video in the first screen without poster
items.name_de: Video im ersten Bildschirm ohne Poster
items.detect: `video` starting inside the first viewport without `poster`
items.note: blank box until the video loads; no still for reduced motion

items.name: Images without width and height
items.detect: `img` without `width`/`height` attributes and without CSS `aspect-ratio`
items.note: layout shift (CLS)

items.name: Icon tiles
items.detect: an icon inside a rounded, tinted square

items.name: Template section rhythm

items.name: SaaS sequence on a non-SaaS brief

items.flag: full match on a non-SaaS brief

items.name: Pill badges
items.detect: small rounded labels on cards ("New", "Popular")

items.name: Device mockups, countdowns

items.name: Decorative terminal windows

items.name: Content hidden in accordions

items.name: Legends instead of direct labels
items.detect: charts with a separate legend box

items.name: Long scroll without content

items.name: Numbers sprinkled everywhere
items.detect: figures in headings, cards and buttons that the brief did not supply

items.name: Gradients on large surfaces
items.detect: gradient backgrounds covering ≥ 15 % of the viewport or ≥ half its width and 200 px high
items.data: gradients on 52 % of weak vs 22 % of top sites (Taste study)

items.name: Purple-to-blue gradient
items.detect: gradient stops with a violet hue (270 to 335) next to blue or pink

items.name: Radial halo or glow
items.detect: `radial-gradient` backgrounds (pseudo-elements included) that fade to transparent
items.note: radial orbs, spotlight backgrounds

items.name: Dot-grid background
items.detect: repeated radial-gradient background with a tile ≤ 40 px

items.name: Rainbow colours
items.detect: one gradient with at least four chromatic stops spanning more than 180° of hue

items.name: Glass / backdrop-filter
items.detect: `backdrop-filter` on visible elements

items.name: Cream + serif + terracotta cluster (parts present)
items.detect: very light warm ground, serif display, orange-red accent (OKLCH ranges)
items.note: also the look of curated inspiration collections (large serif, cream, floating cards, orbs: Q09 comment)

items.name: Single acid/vermilion accent on near-black
items.detect: ground lightness under 0.22 with one high-chroma lime or vermilion accent

items.name: Purple or violet on black
items.detect: ground lightness under 0.22 with a violet accent (hue 270 to 330, chroma ≥ 0.1)

items.name: Gold accent
items.detect: button, link or heading accent with hue 70 to 95, chroma ≥ 0.08, lightness 0.6 to 0.85
items.note: with navy it is the law/finance sector default

items.name: Pure black body text
items.detect: paragraph text colour #000 on a light ground

items.name: Navy and gold for law, finance, property, insurance
items.name_de: Marine und Gold für Recht, Finanzen, Immobilien
items.detect: tokens and industry

items.name: Purple or teal on cream with gold; orange on off-white

items.name: Warm colours on SaaS structure
items.detect: tomato, mustard and light blue on cream with bento tiles: still SaaS

items.name: AI infographic look
items.detect: dark blue gradient, heavy grotesque, giant periwinkle number, source in monospace

items.name: Scroll-reveal / opacity-0 start states
items.detect: reveal class names and data attributes, and text invisible at rest that appears on scroll

items.name: Pulsing dot

items.name: Bounce or elastic easing
items.detect: `cubic-bezier` timing with y outside 0 to 1 on transitions and animations
items.note: taste shared by most sources, not a standard

items.name: transition: all
items.detect: computed `transition-property: all` with a duration

items.name: Custom cursor
items.detect: `cursor: none` or `cursor: url(...)`

items.name: Hover lift on every card
items.detect: transforms on hover on repeated elements

items.name: Hover animation on everything, animated arrows
items.detect: transitions on every interactive element; arrows that slide on hover
items.note: not an argument against hover and focus states (WCAG/BFSG)

items.name: Cursor followers
items.detect: elements or backgrounds bound to pointer position

items.name: Slider, intro sequence, preloader, scroll hijacking
items.detect: carousels in the first screen, splash screens, `wheel` handlers that take over scrolling

items.name: Em dashes in running text
items.detect: count of the em dash "—" in visible running text (headings, nav, code excluded); the spaced German en dash "–" is the normal Gedankenstrich and is not counted
items.flag: more than 2 per page, or more than 1 per 250 words
items.note: house rules may set 0

items.name: Arrow "→" on buttons/links
items.detect: arrow characters at the start or end of link and button text

items.name: Middle-dot meta strings
items.detect: text elements with two or more " · " separators

items.name: Filler vocabulary (EN)
items.detect: visible text against the list

items.name: Filler vocabulary (DE)
items.detect: visible text against the list

items.name: "It's not X, it's Y" pattern
items.detect: EN "it's not …, it's …" / "this isn't …, it's …"; DE "Es ist nicht …, es ist …" / "Das ist kein …, das ist …"
items.note: plain "nicht nur …, sondern auch" is normal German and not counted

items.name: Three dots instead of the ellipsis
items.detect: "..." in visible text

items.name: Hedging copy
items.detect: "could", "might", "potentially" stacked in claims (DE: "könnte", "eventuell", "in vielen Fällen")

items.name: Emoji as icons
items.detect: emoji characters used as list or feature icons (partly caught by three-cards)

items.name: Confident opener + short emphasis sentence
items.detect: a strong claim followed by a two-to-four-word sentence, repeated

items.name: Default icon library as decoration
items.detect: SVG or icon-font class names of Lucide, Feather, Heroicons, Tabler, Phosphor, Material, Font Awesome
items.flag: more than 0 on brand surfaces without a written reason
items.note: product register: one coherent library is expected; Q37 names Lucide as tell number one

items.name: Sparkle icon for "AI"
items.detect: "✨" or a sparkles icon class

items.name: Generated photos of people or places presented as real
items.name_de: Generierte Fotos von Menschen/Orten als echt
items.detect: provenance check of every photo; glossy people "who never had a bad day", wrong hands
items.note: legal risk; AI Act Art. 50 for photorealistic output

items.name: Stock clichés
items.detect: handshake, team pointing at a laptop, headset smile, lightbulb, puzzle pieces
items.flag: more than 0 without a written reason

items.name: Stock illustration sets
items.detect: unDraw, Humaaans, Open Peeps
items.flag: more than 0 on brand surfaces without a written reason

items.name: Generated image used as asset
items.detect: an image-to-site or generated mockup shipped as a page image
items.flag: more than 0 (generated images are references only)

items.name: Repeats a recent structure
items.detect: same topology and type pair as any of the last three entries in `.kiekkist/log.json` or Kiekkist themes (kk_compare)

items.name: Repeats a rejected mechanism
items.detect: mechanism named under "Rejects" in the profile
items.flag: match without the brief demanding it

items.name: DESIGN.md short and written by a human
items.name_de: DESIGN.md kurz und von Menschen geschrieben
items.detect: keep DESIGN.md and house rules short; a human writes or edits them; do not let the model generate the rule file
items.note: ETH study (arXiv 2602.11988, verified in part): model-written context files lowered agent success by 0.5 to 2 %, human-written ones raised it by about 4 %, at about 20 % more cost. Measured on coding agents, not on design.

items.name: Critic sees only screenshots, in a fresh session
items.name_de: Kritik nur mit Screenshots in frischer Sitzung
items.detect: the critique sub-agent gets brief, decision, screenshots and check report, never the build conversation or the original prompt

items.name: Deliberate deletion pass
items.detect: one round that only removes: sections without a claim, decoration, repeated proof, filler copy
items.note: "AI adds, it rarely removes"

items.name: Pass/fail acceptance before delivery
items.detect: review the AI diff like a pull request from a stranger; hard failures block delivery

items.name: Still right after the third prompt
items.name_de: Stimmt es nach dem dritten Prompt noch?
items.detect: check spacing, states (error, empty, edit) and mobile after iterations, not only the first screen

items.name: Let the model ask first
items.detect: briefing questions before building; otherwise gaps are filled with "good enough"

items.name: Lab LCP on a throttled phone
items.detect: lab run at 412x823, DPR 1.75, isMobile, CDP throttling latency 562.5 ms, 188,743 B/s down, 86,400 B/s up, CPU 4x; quiet = 1 s without requests and long tasks (max 15 s); median of the runs (1 by default, 3 with --perf); third-party hosts blocked; last largest-contentful-paint entry
items.flag: warn above 2.5 s, error above 4.0 s
items.note: Core Web Vitals thresholds applied to a lab value; never reported as field data

items.name: Lab CLS on a throttled phone
items.detect: lab run at 412x823, DPR 1.75, isMobile, CDP throttling latency 562.5 ms, 188,743 B/s down, 86,400 B/s up, CPU 4x; quiet = 1 s without requests and long tasks (max 15 s); median of the runs (1 by default, 3 with --perf); third-party hosts blocked; largest session window of layout shifts (gap < 1 s, window ≤ 5 s); a second value after scrolling is info (--perf)
items.note: Core Web Vitals thresholds applied to a lab value

items.name: Lab Total Blocking Time on a throttled phone
items.detect: lab run at 412x823, DPR 1.75, isMobile, CDP throttling latency 562.5 ms, 188,743 B/s down, 86,400 B/s up, CPU 4x; quiet = 1 s without requests and long tasks (max 15 s); median of the runs (1 by default, 3 with --perf); third-party hosts blocked; Σ max(0, duration − 50 ms) of long tasks between FCP and the quiet point
items.flag: warn above 200 ms, error above 600 ms
items.note: Lighthouse mobile scoring bands

items.name: Transfer weight of the first load
items.detect: encodedDataLength of all first-party responses of the lab load (CDP), file and HTML targets via a gzip loopback server
items.flag: warn above 1,000 KB (H), stronger above 2,500 KB (Web Almanac median, D)
items.note: deliberately below the median: the median mobile page fails CWV (48 % pass); Lighthouse flags > 5,000 KiB (S); first-party only

items.name: JavaScript transfer
items.detect: encodedDataLength of Script responses of the lab load
items.flag: warn above 150 KB (H), stronger above 350 KB
items.note: Russell 2023: 300-350 KiB JS is the ceiling for p75 devices; Web Almanac 2025 median 632 KB (D)

items.name: HTML, CSS and fonts on the critical path
items.name_de: HTML, CSS und Schriften im kritischen Pfad
items.detect: encodedDataLength of Document, Stylesheet and Font responses of the lab load
items.flag: warn above 150 KB, stronger above 250 KB
items.note: Russell 2023 budget

items.name: Too many or too heavy font files
items.name_de: Zu viele oder zu schwere Schriftdateien
items.detect: Font responses of the lab load: count and bytes
items.flag: warn above 4 files or 150 KB, stronger above 6 files or 250 KB
items.note: Web Almanac 2025 median fonts 122 KB (D); font CDNs are already a hard failure (font-cdn)

items.name: Font files not in WOFF2 or without font-display
items.name_de: Schriften nicht als WOFF2 oder ohne font-display
items.detect: font responses whose MIME type or file name is not WOFF2; @font-face rules (same-origin sheets) without font-display
items.note: 65 % of font requests are WOFF2; half of the pages use font-display: swap

items.name: LCP image lazy-loaded
items.detect: LCP element of the lab run is an img with loading="lazy"
items.note: web.dev guidance; 16-17 % of mobile pages do it (D)

items.name: LCP image without fetchpriority
items.detect: LCP img without fetchpriority="high" and without a matching link rel=preload as=image
items.note: only 17.3 % of mobile pages set it (D)

items.name: LCP image not in the initial HTML
items.detect: LCP image is a CSS background, or neither its src/srcset nor its file name occurs in the raw HTML response
items.note: median resource load delay on poor-LCP sites 1,290 ms

items.name: Heavy LCP image
items.detect: encodedDataLength of the LCP image in the lab load
items.flag: warn above 200 KB, stronger above 400 KB
items.note: download is under 10 % of LCP on most poor sites (D): discovery and TTFB first

items.name: Images larger than needed
items.detect: visible img at 390 (after scrolling once): wasted ≈ bytes × (1 − (w×3 · h×3) / (naturalWidth · naturalHeight)); bytes from the lab load, Resource Timing or the file
items.flag: per image ≥ 4 KiB wasted; page total above 300 KB (H)
items.note: DPR 3 keeps it lenient: what is flagged is oversized even for the sharpest phones; images without width/height are counted by img-dimensions

items.name: Layout shift when web fonts arrive
items.detect: extra run (with --perf) with font responses delayed 1,500 ms: sum of layout shifts within 200 ms after a document.fonts loadingdone event
items.note: share of the 0.1 CLS budget (S) is a house line; fix with size-adjust/ascent-override or font-display: optional

items.name: Horizontal scroller without cue or keyboard access
items.name_de: Seitlicher Scroller ohne Hinweis oder Tastatur
items.detect: elements at 390 with overflow-x auto/scroll (or scroll-snap x) and scrollWidth > clientWidth: next item 15-85 % visible or arrows; tabindex or focusable content; phone link, form field, prices or navigation inside
items.flag: no peek and no arrows, no keyboard access, or essential content inside
items.note: NN/g 2014; keyboard part WCAG 2.1.1 (axe scrollable-region-focusable reports it too); data tables in a scroll wrapper are skipped

items.name: Content only reachable by hover
items.detect: CSSOM: :hover rules that reveal (display, visibility, opacity, height, clip-path) an element hidden at rest, with no :focus/:focus-within/:focus-visible twin, no click toggle (aria-expanded, details) and not scoped to @media (hover: hover)
items.flag: error when the revealed content holds links or buttons; warn otherwise
items.note: WCAG 2.1.1 and 1.4.13; touch screens have no hover. Complements hover-content (dismissible/hoverable) from the accessibility pass

items.name: Sticky chrome takes too much of the phone screen
items.name_de: Fixe Leisten nehmen zu viel Handy-Bildschirm
items.detect: at 390x844, scrolled to 40 % of the page: union of fixed/sticky bars (≥ 40 % wide) glued to the top or bottom edge; consent dialogs reported apart; hide-on-scroll-down noted
items.flag: top above 15 % (127 px), stronger above 25 % (211 px); top + bottom above 30 %
items.note: NN/g 2021 content-to-chrome ratio; the percentages are house lines (H). Focus under sticky bars: focus-obscured

items.name: No primary action in the first phone screen
items.detect: at 390x844 and 360x780 without scrolling: a filled button, tel:/mailto: link or a link reading Kontakt/Anfrage/Termin/Angebot/anrufen fully inside the screen above any bottom bar
items.note: NN/g 2018: 57 % of viewing time above the fold, 74 % in two screens (desktop; the mobile transfer is an assumption)

items.name: Primary action only at the screen edge
items.detect: vertical centre of the primary actions at 390x844 as share of the screen height
items.flag: all of them in the top 12 % or bottom 5 %
items.note: info only: centre and lower middle are tapped most accurately; the thumb-zone heat map is a myth

items.name: Too few or too many words in the first phone screen
items.name_de: Zu wenige oder zu viele Wörter im ersten Handy-Bildschirm
items.detect: words of visible text nodes intersecting the first 390x844 screen (no aria-hidden, no consent dialog)
items.note: house range; people read about 20 % of the words (M). Desktop text wall: first-screen-words

items.name: H1 not fully in the first phone screen
items.name_de: H1 nicht ganz im ersten Handy-Bildschirm
items.detect: first visible h1 at 390x844 and 360x780: rect inside the screen above any bottom bar; line boxes via Range.getClientRects
items.flag: not fully visible, or more than 4 lines
items.note: derived from fold-57; desktop line count: h1-lines

items.name: Body text too small on the phone
items.name_de: Fließtext auf dem Handy zu klein
items.detect: median computed font-size of visible p, li, dd, td with at least 40 characters at 390
items.note: browser default 16 px, Apple body 17 pt, Material 16 sp; Rello 2016 (M, desktop): comprehension improved up to 18 pt

items.name: Line length off on the phone
items.detect: median characters per line at 390 of paragraphs with at least 120 characters: content width / average glyph width (canvas measureText in the computed font)
items.note: Dyson 2004 (contested); at 390 with 16 px gutters and 17 px type expect 38-45. Desktop: the hard line-length rule (above 80) already covers the widest viewport

items.name: Large touch targets packed too tightly
items.detect: targets ≥ 44x44 at 390 whose edges are closer than 8 px to another target
items.note: info only: WCAG 2.5.8 (target-size) is the hard rule

items.name: Horizontal overflow at 360 px
items.detect: the 390 page resized to 360x780: documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth
items.note: WCAG 2.2, 1.4.10; 360x780 is 4.5 % of German phone traffic

items.name: First-screen block sized with 100vh
items.detect: elements in the first 390 screen at least 90 % of its height whose matched rules or inline style set height/min-height in vh without an svh/dvh/lvh value
items.note: mobile address bar: use 100svh or 100dvh (web.md format traps)

items.name: Phone number without tel: link
items.detect: German phone pattern ((+49|0049|0) and 7-15 digits, not after IBAN/BIC/USt/Fax) in the page text and no a[href^="tel:"] on the page
items.note: web.md format traps

items.name: E-mail or phone field with a text keyboard
items.detect: input type text/search whose name, id, label, placeholder or autocomplete says e-mail or phone (not both)
items.note: autocomplete tokens themselves: autocomplete-missing (WCAG 1.3.5)
